notes.title: âge 2020 Fan Survey and Special Interview from Twinfinite!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Tell us what you want to see next from âge!

The 20th anniversary ended with a blast last October 21st, 2019, and now we're curious about what fans are most looking forward to next among âge's games! The results from the survey above will be used as reference for our future plans, like projects that can be greenlit for localization and events we'll attend.

The survey will end on February 4th, and results will only be visible after that.

Twinfinite Special Interview

In addition to this short update, we're happy to share with you that Giuseppe Nelva from Twinfinite.net has just come all the way to Japan to visit us, and returned with a special interview once again!

The two articles below were shared on our social media accounts:

Muv-Luv Alternative Sequel Muv-Luv Integrate Will Have a Brand New Protagonist

Muv-Luv Series Could Appear on More Console Platforms, Possibly Including PS5

And here's the main interview!

The Big Muv-Luv Interview: Developers Discuss Integrate, Alternative Anime, Mikhail, and the Future

Please expect more Muv-Luv goodness in the coming months :)

Cheers,

The Muv-Luv Team

notes.title: Photons side stories status, SGM online, and MLA Director's Cut patch update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The translation team is currently working on photonmelodies, as they've recently finished the localization of photonflowers! We're now at the programming and debugging phase, so keep your eyes peeled for updates in the coming months!

If you want to know more about the contents of photonflowers and photonmelodies, please visit our forum page here: https://community.muvluv.moe/index.php?/topic/144-what-are-photonflowers-and-photonmelodies-do-they-include-muv-luv-altered-fable/

Sekai Project's SGM is online!
 
https://sgm.sekaiproject.com

"Steam Game Manager" or "SGM" is an awesome system created by Sekai Project to help give bonus game keys/dlcs to owners of an existing game.

If you own the original AppID of Muv-Luv and/or Muv-Luv Alternative, and want to get the new AppID(s), just simply follow the steps below:
1. Set your "Game Details" to public (under Edit Profile → Privacy Settings) You can set it back to private after receiving the key(s)
2. Login to SGM using your Steam account.
3  Set a valid e-mail, then confirm it by clicking the link in your e-mail.
4. Click the "Request Key" button(s).

After that, you just need to wait for a few hours then you'll be notified of the new key(s) assigned to your account via e-mail. 

SGM is still a BETA product, so please let us know if you encountered any issues.

Note: We can no longer generate keys for the old AppID.

Muv-Luv Alternative Director's Cut Patch is underway!

Last but not the least, we're quite happy to say we've started working on the Director's Cut patch of Muv-Luv Alternative. Thanks again to everyone who supported us in making this happen. Rest assured we'll keep you updated of the development progress of the patch and photonflowers.

Cheers,

The Muv-Luv Team

notes.title: Original AppID owners can now get their live version copies!
notes.content:
Greetings and salutations everyone,

Our trusted comrades at Sekai Project have begun working on the third party solution using Steam API, to help distribute the live version Steam keys to the original AppID owners. It may take around the 4th week of April for them to complete it.

However, as the announcement title says, the original owners can already get their live version Steam key(s)!

1. Just simply send us an e-mail at tanaka@ixtl.jp with the following details:
a. link to your Steam user account.
b. (optional) if you have reviewed the game(s), send us a link to the review(s).

2. Add http://steamcommunity.com/id/tanaka_muvluv/ as a friend

3. Once the friend request has been approved, send them a private message containing your email address.

It'll take around 1-7 business days for us to send the key, depending on the amount of requests.

Cheers,

Marimo@The Muv-Luv Team
